# orion canvas

Canvases and their layout

```sh
orion canvas <command> [options]
```

## orion canvas list

List canvases and mark the active one

```sh
orion canvas list [options]
```

| Argument     | Description                    |
| ------------ | ------------------------------ |
| `--archived` | List archived canvases instead |
| `--json`     | Print JSON                     |

## orion canvas create

Create a canvas with its own data folder

```sh
orion canvas create [name] [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                     |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `[name]`          | Canvas name. Omit it to derive one from --label |
| `--label <value>` | Display label                                   |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                      |

## orion canvas rename

Change a canvas's display label

```sh
orion canvas rename [name] [label] [options]
```

| Argument  | Description       |
| --------- | ----------------- |
| `[name]`  | Canvas name       |
| `[label]` | New display label |
| `--json`  | Print JSON        |

## orion canvas set

Set a canvas's cover or background

```sh
orion canvas set [options]
```

| Argument               | Description                                                                    |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--cover <value>`      | Image asset id for the cover, from orion media add --json (empty to clear)     |
| `--background <value>` | Color, color token such as card.background, or image asset id (empty to clear) |
| `--header <value>`     | Markdown with layout HTML shown over the top of the canvas (empty to clear)    |
| `--json`               | Print JSON                                                                     |

## orion canvas archive

Archive a canvas. Its data stays in place, and restore brings it back. The active canvas and default can't be archived

```sh
orion canvas archive [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `[name]` | Canvas name |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion canvas restore

Restore an archived canvas with its data

```sh
orion canvas restore [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description          |
| -------- | -------------------- |
| `[name]` | Archived canvas name |
| `--json` | Print JSON           |

## orion canvas use

Make a canvas the active one

```sh
orion canvas use [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `[name]` | Canvas name |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion canvas current

Print the active canvas

```sh
orion canvas current [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion canvas path

Print where this canvas keeps its data

```sh
orion canvas path [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion canvas check

Report layout problems: overlaps, items outside their group, dangling links, and groups waiting for layout

```sh
orion canvas check [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `--group <value>` | Only problems in this group or inside it |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                               |
